## Map 

```{r}
# Using police boundaries from 2021 as official boundaries for Auckland city police district have not changed till present
library(sf)
police_districts <- st_read("nz-police-district-boundaries-29-april-2021.gpkg")
```

```{r}
# Resident Population per 250m for Auckland 
pop_per_250m <- read.csv("new-zealand-estimated-resident-population-grid-250-metre.csv")
head(pop_per_250m)

# Convert dataframe to sf for spatial data, crs = 2193 for NZ
pop_per_250m <- st_as_sf(pop_per_250m, coords = c("CENTROID_X", "CENTROID_Y"), crs = 2193)
```


```{r}
# head(police_districts) shows that the police_districts of "Auckland City" exists 
aklcity_boundary <- police_districts[police_districts$DISTRICT_N == "Auckland City",]
#aklcity_boundary

# matching coordinate systems using st_crs() and then transforming the aklcity_boundary to the same crs/coordinate system 
aklcity_boundary  <- aklcity_boundary |> 
  st_transform(st_crs(pop_per_250m))

# filtering for the rows in the population dataset for the auckland city distict population
aklcity_pop <- pop_per_250m |>
  st_filter(aklcity_boundary)

# sum all the columns named "PopEst2022", "PopEst2023", "PopEst2024", "PopEst2025" using colsum to add the populations for each year within the auckland_city district 

colSums(st_drop_geometry(aklcity_pop)[c("PopEst2022", "PopEst2023", "PopEst2024", "PopEst2025")], na.rm = TRUE)
```

We found data on the police boundaries from 2021 and we selected the boundary for Auckland City.
Using the estimated resident population per 250m for Auckland dataset (2022 to 2025), filter rows for coordinates that are in aklcity_boundary. Then sum the rows of the columns for each year to add all populations.





# Making a map
```{r}

# Using police_districts dataset again for Auckland City boundary

# regions used to ensure that correct SA2 areas for auckland region are selected
regions <- st_read("regional-council-2025-clipped.gpkg")

# SA2 areas in wide Auckland Region: selected by cropping NZ to a region of wider Auckland then downloading the SA2 dataset
sa2 <- st_read("statistical-area-2-higher-geographies-2025.gpkg")

auckland_region <- regions %>%
  filter(REGC2025_V1_00_NAME == "Auckland")

aklcity_boundary <- police_districts %>%
  filter(DISTRICT_N == "Auckland City")

# SA2 areas in Auckland City Police District: using st_point_on_surface() to count how many data points of sa2 lie on the Auckland region
points <- st_point_on_surface(sa2)
akl_sa2 <- sa2 %>%
  filter(lengths(st_intersects(points,auckland_region)) > 0)

# SA2 areas in Auckland City Police District: using st_point_on_surface() to count how many data points of sa2 lie on the Auckland city police district
points2 <- st_point_on_surface(akl_sa2)
aklcity_sa2 <- akl_sa2 %>%
  filter(lengths(st_intersects(points2,aklcity_boundary)) > 0)
```





```{r}
# Using ggplot:

# st_union() to combine all SA2 areas and st_sf() to convert this to a dataframe
aklcity_outline <- st_sf(geometry = st_union(aklcity_sa2))

aklcity_map <- ggplot() +
  # All SA2s areas of outer Auckland region in grey with white border
  geom_sf(data = akl_sa2, fill = "grey", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +

  # Auckland city police district regional outline
  geom_sf(data = aklcity_outline, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  
  # Original data selection included the region being too large so longitude and latitude west, east, south, north were changed to crop the plot
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(174.65, 174.90),
    ylim = c(-36.95, -36.78),
    # 4326 is the Geographic coordinate system to tell R that the ranges stand for longitude and latitude 
    default_crs = st_crs(4326) ) +
  labs(title = "Auckland City Police District", subtitle = "SA2 areas within the Auckland Region with Auckland City Police District boundary") +
  theme_void()

aklcity_map 
```



# Using meshcodes to turn them into wider SA2 regions for easier interpretation of larger areas such a suburb or part of a suburb

### reading in data 
```{r}
# victim_tp contains victims as observations with the meshcode of area of crime 

#victim_tp <- read.csv("victim_time_place.csv") ---- file wasnt encoded properly so read.csv didnt work at first 

victim_tp <- read.delim(
  "victim_time_place.csv",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-16LE",
  skip = 0
)

meshblocks <- st_read("meshblock-higher-geographies-2025.gpkg")
names(victim_tp)
names(meshblocks)
```



### turning meshcodes into sa2 regions
```{r}
victim_tp <- victim_tp |>
  mutate(Year = year(my(Year.Month))) 
victim_tp

meshblock_df <- meshblocks |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(MB2025_V1_00, SA22025_V1_00) |>
  rename(Meshblock = MB2025_V1_00, SA2 = SA22025_V1_00) |>
  mutate(Meshblock = as.integer(Meshblock))
meshblock_df

victim_sa2 <- victim_tp |>
  left_join(meshblock_df,by = "Meshblock")
```



```{r}
victim_totals <- victim_sa2 |>
  filter(!is.na(SA2), Year == 2023 |Year == 2024| Year == 2025) |>
  group_by(SA2, Year) |>
  summarise(victimisations = sum(Victimisations, na.rm = TRUE))

victim_totals

# Join dataset SA2 values to current map SA2 dataset
aklcity_victims <- aklcity_sa2 |>
  left_join(victim_totals, by = c("SA22025_V1_00" = "SA2")) |>
  filter(!is.na(Year))
```



```{r}
aklcity_map <- ggplot() +

  # All surrounding SA2 areas in grey
  geom_sf(
    data = akl_sa2,
    fill = "grey85",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +

  # Colour Auckland City SA2s by victimisations
  geom_sf(
    data = aklcity_victims,
    aes(fill = victimisations),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +

  # Colour gradient
  scale_fill_stepsn(colours = c("#fee8e1","#fcbba1","#fc9272","#fb6a4a","#ef3b2c","#cb181d","#a50f15","#800B10","#4A0008"),
    breaks = c(100, 250, 400, 500, 700, 900, 1200, 1600),
    na.value = "grey70") +
  
  facet_wrap(~Year, ncol = 3) +

  # Crop 
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(174.65, 174.90),
    ylim = c(-36.95, -36.78),
    default_crs = st_crs(4326)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Victimisations in Auckland City Police District",
    subtitle = "2023 to 2025",
    fill = "Victimisation Count per SA2 region") +
  theme_void()




top3_2023 <- aklcity_victims |>
  filter(Year == 2023) |>
  slice_max(victimisations, n = 7)

top3_2024 <- aklcity_victims |>
  filter(Year == 2024) |>
  slice_max(victimisations, n = 7)

top3_2025 <- aklcity_victims |>
  filter(Year == 2025) |>
  slice_max(victimisations, n = 7)

aklcity_map <- aklcity_map +
  geom_sf_text(
    data = top3_2023,
    aes(label = SA22025_V1_00_NAME),
    size = 2.2,
    colour = "black",
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_sf_text(
    data = top3_2024,
    aes(label = SA22025_V1_00_NAME),
    size = 2.2,
    colour = "black",
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_sf_text(
    data = top3_2025,
    aes(label = SA22025_V1_00_NAME),
    size = 2.2,
    colour = "black",
    check_overlap = TRUE
  )
aklcity_map

ggsave(
  "aklcity_map_2023-2025.png",
  plot = aklcity_map,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

## top 3 and top 5 suburb total count for 2023 - 2025
```{r}

top3_suburbs <- aklcity_victims |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(Year %in% c(2023, 2024, 2025)) |>
  group_by(Year, SA22025_V1_00_NAME) |>
  summarise(total_victims = sum(victimisations), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  arrange(desc(total_victims), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  filter(row_number() <= 3)|>
  rename("Suburb" = 2, "Total Victims"= 3)

top3_suburbs


top5_suburbs <- aklcity_victims |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(Year %in% c(2023, 2024, 2025)) |>
  group_by(Year, SA22025_V1_00_NAME) |>
  summarise(total_victims = sum(victimisations), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  arrange(desc(total_victims), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  filter(row_number() <= 5)|>
  rename("Suburb" = 2, "Total Victims"= 3)

top5_suburbs

```


## proportion of suburbs with greater than 100 victimisations per suburb per year 
```{r}
prop_over100 <- aklcity_victims |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(Year %in% c(2023, 2024, 2025)) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(suburb_proportion = mean(victimisations > 100, na.rm = TRUE))

prop_over100
```
